stem: One humidity sensor near a dehumidifier outlet reads much drier than four canopy sensors. What should a Technician I do first?
choices: Change the entire room setpoint to match the dry sensor
Check the sensor location and calibration/status before treating it as representative of the crop
Ignore all canopy sensors because the dry sensor is closest to equipment
Increase irrigation to compensate for the dry reading
rationale: A sensor near equipment discharge may measure a local microclimate. Placement and calibration should be checked before broad room changes are made from one outlying sensor.
